nome_jp: スクラッパー・ドラゴン
testo:
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, you and your opponent play Gachinko Judge. If you win, destroy any number of your opponent's creatures that have total power 5000 or less. Gachinko Judge
Double Breaker
